name: Karakeep
short_desc: Bookmark everything and keep it organized
author: Karakeep
description: Karakeep is a self-hosted bookmark manager for saving links, notes, and images. It includes full-text search, automatic content fetching, and optional AI-powered tagging.

form_fields.label: AI API Key
form_fields.hint: Optional. OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible provider API key.

form_fields.label: AI Text Model
form_fields.hint: Model used for text tagging and summarization.

form_fields.label: AI Image Model
form_fields.hint: Vision-capable model used for image tagging.

form_fields.label: Use Max Completion Tokens
form_fields.hint: Disable for Ollama Cloud, which supports max_tokens instead.

form_fields.label: Automatic Embedding Indexing
form_fields.hint: Disable for Ollama Cloud unless a compatible embedding model is configured.
